question: A 30-year-old computer scientist receives negative feedback on a recent project from his senior associate. He is told sternly that he must improve his performance on the next project. Later that day, he yells at his intern, a college student, for not showing enough initiative, though he had voiced only satisfaction with his performance up until this point. Which of the following psychological defense mechanisms is he demonstrating?
analysis: The individual is displacing his feelings of inadequacy and frustration from the negative feedback onto the intern, who is in a less powerful position. This is a classic example of displacement as a defense mechanism.
